rows.grounds: epithet attributing supreme status to cakraṃ
numeral member of compound describing petra
second member of compound indicating petals
compound adjective describing cakraṃ as having a central pericarp

items.question: What rank, form, and structural features characterize the sixth cakra?
premises: The sixth cakra is identified as the subject of description.
This cakra is characterized as royal in status.
The cakra includes a central pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is a royal center structured with eight petals and a pericarp.
uncertainties: The precise symbolic sense of rājānam as royal or supreme is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: And the sixth cakra is royal, having eight petals and a pericarp.
